methods.title: Payment details
methods.heroTitle: Get paid straight to your account
methods.heroText: Add the bank accounts and wallets shippers can pay you into. The money goes directly to you. FLITO never holds it.

trust.private: Shown only to shippers who book you

methods.yourAccountsHint: Shippers see your primary account first.
methods.emptyTitle: How do you want to be paid?
methods.emptyText: Add at least one. Shippers see it on their booking with you.
methods.limitReached: You have 5 accounts, the most you can keep. Remove one to add another.
methods.safetyNote: FLITO will never ask for your PIN, password or OTP. Never share them with anyone.
methods.loadFailed: Could not load your payment details
methods.removeMessage: Shippers will no longer see it. Payments already recorded stay.

card.qrHint: Scan with any bank app, eSewa or Khalti. Check that the name shown is {{name}} before you pay.

form.addTitle: Add a way to be paid
form.otherBankHint: Development banks, finance companies and cooperatives
form.accountNameHint: Exactly as it is on the account, so shippers can check it
form.accountNumberHint: Leave it empty if you only want to share the QR
form.walletNameHint: The name shown in your {{wallet}} app
form.qrBankHint: Open your bank app, show your "receive money" QR (Fonepay or NepalPay) and take a screenshot.
form.qrWalletHint: Open {{wallet}}, show your "receive money" QR and take a screenshot.
form.needBankName: Type the name of the bank
form.needAccountOrQr: Add the account number, the QR, or both
form.savedMessage: Shippers will see this on their bookings with you.

booking.title: Payment
booking.awaitingShipper: {{amount}} waiting for the owner to confirm
booking.payOwnerHint: Pay into one of these with your bank app, eSewa or Khalti, then tap "I have paid".
booking.noAccounts: The owner hasn't added a bank or wallet yet. Pay as you agreed with them, then record it here.
booking.ownerNoAccountsTitle: Shippers can't see how to pay you
booking.ownerNoAccountsText: Add your bank account, eSewa or Khalti.
booking.confirmMessage: Check your bank or wallet first. This adds it to what the shipper has paid.
booking.disputeHint: The shipper will be told to check the transfer. You can say what you see.
booking.disputePlaceholder: Optional, e.g. nothing came into my Nabil account

report.referenceHint: From the bank, eSewa or Khalti receipt. It helps the owner find your payment.
report.badAmount: Enter the amount in whole rupees
report.sentShipper: The owner will check their account and confirm it.
report.sentOwner: It now counts towards what the shipper has paid.

commission.title: FLITO fees
commission.heroTitle: A small fee on each completed trip
commission.heroText: FLITO charges truck owners a small part of each trip's fare once it is delivered. Shippers pay nothing. Your trips are added up every Nepali month, and you pay by the {{day}}th of the next month.
commission.startsOn: Fees apply to trips booked from {{date}}. Trips booked before then have no fee.

status.overdueText: Pay it to keep making offers. Trips you have already booked carry on.
status.dueText: Your bill for last month is ready.
status.awaitingText: FLITO is checking the {{amount}} you paid. It counts once confirmed.
status.clearText: Thank you. New trips are added to this month's bill.

commission.payHint: Pay into one of FLITO's official accounts with your bank app, eSewa or Khalti, then tap "I have paid FLITO".
commission.noAccounts: FLITO's payment details aren't set up yet. Contact FLITO support to pay.
commission.sentMessage: FLITO will check its account and confirm it.
commission.noTrips: No completed trips with a fee yet.
commission.loadFailed: Could not load your FLITO fees.
commission.bookingFeeEstimate: {{amount}}, added to your monthly bill when delivered
commission.offerFee: FLITO fee on this offer: {{amount}} per truck, added to your monthly bill. Shippers pay nothing.
commission.homeStartText: A small fee on each completed trip, billed monthly. You'll see the exact fee before every offer, and your first 5 trips are free. Shippers pay nothing.
commission.welcomeLeft_one: Welcome offer: your next trip is free ({{count}} of {{total}} free trips left).
commission.welcomeLeft_other: Welcome offer: your next {{count}} trips are free (of {{total}}).
commission.welcomeUsed: You have used all your free welcome trips.
commission.bookingFeeWelcome: none, this is one of your free welcome trips
commission.howText: You always know the fee before you take a trip: it is shown when you send an offer, on the booking, and on your monthly bill. Cancelled trips have no fee.
commission.offerFee_welcome: No FLITO fee: this would be one of your free welcome trips.
commission.offerFee_notStarted: No FLITO fee: fees haven't started yet.
